```{r}
#| label: load packages

library(dplyr, quietly = TRUE, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
```

## Descriptives

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: Sample Discriptives
descr <- readRDS("../../Data/descriptives/descr0.RDS")



raw <- descr |> select(study, n, other, female, male, m_age, sd_age, min_age, max_age) |> 
  arrange(study)


other <- sum(raw$other)
N <- sum(raw$n)
other_pct <- other/N * 100
male_pct <- sum(raw$male) / N * 100
female_pct <- sum(raw$female) / N * 100

knitr::kable(raw, digits = 2)
```

Participants who indicated `other` as their gender were not included in the analyses. In total `r other` participants were excluded (`r round(other_pct, 1)`%).
The percentage of female was (`r round(female_pct, 1)`%), and of male (`r round(male_pct, 1)`%)


```{r}
#| tbl-cap: Sample Included in Analysis
descr <- readRDS("../../Data/descriptives/descr.RDS")

raw <- descr |> select(study, n, female, male, m_age, sd_age, min_age, max_age) |> 
  arrange(study) |> mutate(pct_female = female / n * 100)

male_pct <- sum(raw$male) / sum(raw$n) * 100
female_pct <- sum(raw$female) / sum(raw$n) * 100

knitr::kable(raw, digits = 1)

```




## Reliabitlies

### Negative Affect

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: Scale Reliabilities for Negative Affect (Omega Between and Within)
omega <- readRDS("../../Data/descriptives/omega.RDS")
o_within <- omega |> filter(label == "omega_within") |> pull(est) |> summary()
o_between <- omega |> filter(label == "omega_between") |> pull(est) |> summary()


omega |> arrange(label, study) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

`omega between` ranged from `r round(o_between[1], 2)` to `r round(o_between[6], 2)`, whereas `omega within` ranged from `r round(o_within[1], 2)` to `r round(o_within[6], 2)`


### Emotion Suppression (trait)

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: Scale Reliabilities for Emotion Suppersion (ERQ or RESS)
alpha <- readRDS("../../Data/descriptives/alpha.RDS")
alpha |> arrange(study) |> 
  select(study, raw_alpha, scale) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

```

The reliability of the Emotion Supression trait scales (ERQ and RESS) ranged from `r round(min(alpha$raw_alpha), 2)` to `r round(max(alpha$raw_alpha), 2)`
